_about: Public-domain Beverly Carradine (1848-1919), Methodist minister of New Orleans and St Louis and Holiness evangelist, for the Word Hoard: Sanctification, Church Entertainments, A Journey to Palestine, The Second Blessing in Symbol, Pastoral Sketches, The Old Man, The Better Way, The Sanctified Life, Revival Sermons, Heart Talks, Pen Pictures, Soul Help, Golden Sheaves, Remarkable Occurrences, Gideon, Beulah Land, A Church Yard Story, Living Illustrations, A Box of Treasure, Yazoo Stories, and Graphic Scenes. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 113 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
